canonical_statement: The codebase is an executable encyclopedia of contextual state transitions.
explainability_statement: Every execution can explain itself linguistically, structurally and evidentially.

expressions.composed_definition: initiate an admitted immutable application package on a node whose capabilities, policy, health and integrity satisfy the deployment contract
read and compare the application package manifest against integrity data before node-side execution can start
derive current capability-scoped condition of an addressable node from fresh observer-bound evidence
create a functioning worker by binding identity, role, team, tenant boundary, VFS namespace, queue, skills, policy, runtime allocation, telemetry channel, receipt ledger and lineage
replay durable deferred work only after dependency health, integrity and lineage are verified
